title: Investigate remaining Codex chat-paste hazards
body:
Investigate (diagnosis first, no fix without evidence) remaining ways a chat paste into a Codex pane is misinterpreted. These exist today and the Insert-separator fix (card nind1d) does not address them. Source: Codex 0.163.0 (tag rust-v0.163.0), codex-rs/tui/src.

1. Modal in the paste->Enter window: an approval or list view that opens between paste and the deferred Enter takes Enter as accept. approval_overlay.rs try_handle_shortcut also binds plain y/a/p/d/n/c, which pasted text can trigger. Foreman holds delivery only for NeedsYou BEFORE the paste (src/chat.rs tick_at).
2. Vim normal mode: pasted chars run as vim commands.
3. History search / transcript search / expanded questions panel capture the keys.
4. A post ending in an @token may open the mention/file popup on apply_paste -> sync_popups, and Enter then selects an item (trigger rule unverified).
5. A Codex stall >60ms mid-paste flushes the paste early; a newline later in the post can then submit a partial message. Candidate mitigation: send Codex single-line frames.

Deliverable: for each item, a reproduction (or evidence it cannot happen), how often it plausibly occurs in fleet use, and a proposed fix that uses ordering or events, never a delay. File follow-up cards for the ones worth fixing.
